message.reasoning_content:
Sum = 17 - 4 + 23 + 8 = 44. Words unique, case-sensitive, dict order: Apple, apple, fig, pear, plum → 5 words.

Create out dir, write files. Let me actually run commands: awk sum, sort -u.

Dict order case-sensitive: standard `sort` in C locale. Locale might affect. Use LC_ALL=C sort -u. Apple < apple (uppercase A=65 < a=97), fig, pear, plum. Good.

Let's run.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "mkdir -p out
awk '{s+=$1} END{print s}' data/a.txt > out/sum.txt
LC_ALL=C sort -u data/b.txt | sed '/^$/d' > out/words.txt
printf 'sum=%s; unique_words=%s\n' "$(cat out/sum.txt)" "$(wc -l < out/words.txt)" > out/notes.txt
echo "--- sum.txt"; cat out/sum.txt
echo "--- words.txt"; cat out/words.txt
echo "--- notes.txt"; cat out/notes.txt
echo "--- ls"; ls -la out"}
